<style>
.modules-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 480px), 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}
.mod-card {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.mod-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 0 0 2px var(--mod-accent, #e0e0f0), 0 0 16px var(--mod-accent, #e0e0f0);
  border-color: var(--mod-accent, #e0e0f0);
}
.mod-thumb {
  width: 100%;
  height: 130px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
}
.mod-header {
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
}
.mod-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.mod-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
.mod-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
}
.mod-body {
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  flex: 1;
}
.mod-grade {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #888);
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  margin-top: auto;
}
.mod-grade span {
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
}

/* Embed wrapper */
.embed-wrap {
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.embed-wrap iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  border: none;
}
.embed-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
  gap: 6px;
}
.embed-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #888);
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.embed-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.embed-btn {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
}
.embed-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Project links */
.proj-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 11px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}
.proj-link:hover {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}
.proj-icon {

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

}
.proj-name {

  font-weight: 500;

}
.proj-sub {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #888);
}
.proj-arrow {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #aaa);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Fullscreen modal */
.fs-modal-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
  z-index: 9999;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.fs-modal-overlay.open {
  display: flex;
}
.fs-modal {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
  border-radius: 12px;
  width: 92vw;
  max-width: 960px;
  max-height: 92vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.fs-modal-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
  gap: 10px;
}
.fs-modal-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.fs-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.fs-modal-btn {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #666);
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.fs-modal-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #333);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.fs-modal-frame {
  flex: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.fs-modal-frame iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 560px;
  border: none;
  display: block;
}
</style>

function ytrOpenModal(iframeSrc, label, externalUrl) {
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal-iframe').src = iframeSrc;
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal-title').textContent = label;
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal-newtab').href = externalUrl;
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal').classList.add('open');
}

function ytrCloseModal() {
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('ytr-modal-iframe').src = '';
}

window.ytrOpenModal = ytrOpenModal;
window.ytrCloseModal = ytrCloseModal;

function buildEmbed(e) {
  if (e.type === 'youtube') {
    var embedUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + e.ytId + '?rel=0';
    var watchUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' + e.ytId;
    return '<div class="embed-wrap">' +
      '<iframe src="' + embedUrl + '" height="185" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe>' +
      '<div class="embed-toolbar">' +
        '<span class="embed-label">' + e.label + '</span>' +
        '<div class="embed-actions">' +
          '<button class="embed-btn" onclick="ytrOpenModal(\'' + embedUrl + '\',\'' + e.label + '\',\'' + watchUrl + '\')">⛶ Fullscreen</button>' +
          '<a class="embed-btn" href="' + watchUrl + '" target="_blank">↗ New tab</a>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }
  if (e.type === 'pdf') {
    var viewerUrl = 'https://docs.google.com/viewerng/viewer?url=' + encodeURIComponent(e.pdfUrl) + '&embedded=true';
    return '<div class="embed-wrap">' +
      '<iframe src="' + viewerUrl + '" height="200" loading="lazy"></iframe>' +
      '<div class="embed-toolbar">' +
        '<span class="embed-label">' + e.label + '</span>' +
        '<div class="embed-actions">' +
          '<button class="embed-btn" onclick="ytrOpenModal(\'' + viewerUrl + '\',\'' + e.label + '\',\'' + e.pdfUrl + '\')">⛶ Fullscreen</button>' +
          '<a class="embed-btn" href="' + e.pdfUrl + '" target="_blank">↗ New tab</a>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }
  return '';
}

function buildLink(l) {
  var dlAttr = l.download ? ' download' : '';
  return '<a class="proj-link" href="' + l.href + '" target="_blank"' + dlAttr + '>' +
    '<div class="proj-icon">' + (l.icon || '📄') + '</div>' +
    '<div>' +
      '<div class="proj-name">' + l.name + '</div>' +
      '<div class="proj-sub">' + l.sub + '</div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<span class="proj-arrow">↗</span>' +
  '</a>';
}

var grid = document.getElementById('ytr-grid');
modules.forEach(function(m) {
  var embedsHtml = m.embeds.map(buildEmbed).join('');
  var linksHtml  = m.links.map(buildLink).join('');
  var card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'mod-card';
  card.style.setProperty('--mod-accent', m.tagColor);
  card.innerHTML =
    (m.img ? '<img class="mod-thumb" src="' + m.img + '" alt="' + m.title + '" onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'">' : '') +
    '<div class="mod-header">' +
      '<div class="mod-tag" style="background:' + m.tagBg + ';color:' + m.tagColor + '">' + m.tag + '</div>' +
      '<div class="mod-title">' + m.title + '</div>' +
      '<p class="mod-desc">' + m.desc + '</p>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="mod-body">' +
      embedsHtml +
      linksHtml +
      '<div class="mod-grade">Grading — <span>' + m.grading + '</span></div>' +
    '</div>';
  grid.appendChild(card);
});

})();
</script>
